title: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Procession of Daoist Deities: Leaf 11（2004.1.11）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 2004.1.11）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1200s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Procession of Daoist Deities: Leaf 11
John L. Severance Fund in honor of Dr. Ju-hsi Chou and Gift of various donors to the department of Asian Art (by exchange)

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Martin, F. R. Zeichnungen nach Wu tao-tze aus der götter- und sagenwelt Chinas. München: F. Bruckmann a.g, 1913.
Giuffrida, Noelle. Representing the Daoist God Zhenwu, the Perfected Warrior, in Late Imperial China. PhD diss. University of Kansas, 2008.（Mentioned: pp. 52-58; Reproduced: p. 317, fig. 2.44）
Gesterkamp, Lennert. The Heavenly Court: Daoist Temple Painting in China, 1200-1400. Leiden: Brill, 2011.（Reproduced: fig. 22）
Chung, Anita. "Re-emergence: New Chinese Galleries and Art Acquisitions of The Cleveland Museum of Art." Orientations vol 44 no. 8 (November/December 2013): 64-75.（Reproduced: p. 66, fig. 3）
Chou, Ju-hsi and Anita Chung. Silent poetry: Chinese paintings from the collection of the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, 2015.（Reproduced: pp. 174-195）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
天蓬大元帥; 天猷副元帥; 翊聖寶德真君; 倉頡; 祐聖真君

馆方英译：Figures labeled right to left: Tianpeng da yuanshuai (Field Marshal Tianpeng); Tianyou fu yuanshuai (Field Marshal Tianyou); Yisheng baode zhenjun (True Lord Yisheng or He who cherishes Virtues); Cang Jie; Yousheng zhenjun (True Lord Yousheng)
